lines: Kurenai's blades simply bounced off the demonic beast's hard scales again and again, unable to leave a single scratch.
Kurenai was drunk and her attacks lacked her usual edge, but more importantly, the beast was simply strong.
The demonic beast manipulated flames, and also attacked masterfully with the spear it wielded.
Ahahaha! Come on, tell me before you turn to ash! Where is the djinn!?
Mari tried to rush in to help, but Kurenai stopped her.
Mari was also drunkenly unsteady, and couldn't really be counted on in combat.
It can't be helped. I didn't really want to use this power, but... *hic!*
She closed her eyes and slowly concentrated her spirit within herself.
Ohh～, what's wrong, Taimanin? Are you giving up already!!?
Suddenly, a demonic aura erupted with tremendous force.
Kurenai simply stood there calmly as it enveloped her. It changed the color of her skin, her eyes, and even the combat suit she was wearingー
Wh-What's going on!? This overwhelming demonic Ki...!!
...Alright then. Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai, ready for combat...
Clad in the demonic aura, Kurenai dashed forward.
Dodging the flames and the spear of the roaring monster, she closed the distance in an instantーーー
Divine Eye Blade: Karmic Demon Siege.
That was the Evil Eye that was passed down within the Shinganji Family, one of the Eight Generals of the Fuma.
It allowed her to see things not of this world,
and then to sever it with her awe-inspiring swordsmanshipー
Even if they were demonic creatures with high regenerative powers, or high-level demons like vampires,
once their "existence" itself was severed, they had no choice but to perish.
Naturally, the mere scales of a demonic beast did not stand a chance against it.
With a cry of anguish, the Salamander's giant body collapsed.
Ugh!? ...W-We're withdrawing!! I didn't hear anything about a monster like you being involved!!
She must've realized that she was at a disadvantage. After irritatingly giving the order to withdraw, Meifeng disappeared into the darkness of the back alley.
Oh my. Calling me a monster again.
With a bitter laugh, Kurenai lowered her swords.
And at the same time, her "demonic" aura dissipated, and Kurenai returned to her former self.
K-Kurenai-san... are you alright? And... what just happened...?
That's... how should I say... It's something like my special skill.
Thanks to it, I'm not drunk anymore and I can properly "see" things again.
Still tilting her head, Mari eventually smiled cheerfully.
But thanks to you, that lady ran away, and most likely no one will come after us anymore.
Yeah, probably. There's also no sign that any other organization is after usー But more importantly...
Kurenai suddenly striked out at Mari.
Mari however, who was supposed to be too drunk to even properly run, easily dodged it.
Wh-What are you doing all of a sudden, Kurenai-san...!!?
Hmph, stop with the actーI believe I told you earlier.
Kurenai's two swords were pointed directly at the terrified Mari.
...That I'd cut you down if you tried anything weirdー
The one who's "standing there" right now is youーisn't it, "Book Djinn?"
